title: Accounting firm Mercadien notifies Esquire Bank customers of breach of audit files
date_note: Day the California Attorney General's register published the filing (from its listing feed; the listing page and the sample notice show no date). The notice says Mercadien detected the incident on 7 November 2025.
geo_basis: firm address as stated in the notice (3625 Quakerbridge Rd, Hamilton Township, NJ)
summary: Mercadien, P.C. CPAs' sample notice, filed with the California Attorney General, says it detected a data security incident on its systems on November 7, 2025, and that files containing personal information were accessed by an unauthorized third party. The data was held in connection with audit work Mercadien performed for Esquire Bank. The filed sample does not list the data types, and the firm says it has no evidence of misuse.
plain: An accounting firm that audited Esquire Bank says an outsider accessed files holding some bank customers' personal details. It is offering free credit monitoring.
exec: A bank's customer data was exposed through its outside auditor; third-party risk for financial institutions.
action: Mercadien's notice offers free Cyberscout credit monitoring (enroll within 90 days of the letter) and urges recipients to monitor accounts and consider a fraud alert or security freeze; questions go to 1-833-851-9633.
impact: Some Esquire Bank customers whose data Mercadien held for audit work; no number given.
